payload.claim: `QUARANTINE_BYTES = events.BOUND_CHARS` is a one-time snapshot taken at import, not a live alias — `_quarantined` below reads `events.BOUND_CHARS` directly and ignores this name entirely. The module-level constant is kept only so the preserved test can still say `implement.QUARANTINE_BYTES`; anyone else who patches or reads this name expecting it to govern the raw-line bound (its historical role) gets a value that can silently diverge from the one actually in effect. The docstring immediately below does disclose this, and the spec's own notes mandated keeping the name reachable, so this is a documented, deliberate tradeoff rather than an oversight — noting it only because it re-introduces, in a dormant form, the 'two constants that happen to agree' shape criterion 3 was written to close.
